📰 General

WWE Announces Strict Ruleset for WarGames Matches at Survivor Series 2025 •

WWE has finalized the rules for the upcoming WarGames matches scheduled for Survivor Series 2025 in San Diego. The event will feature two WarGames contests, one featuring male competitors and another with female wrestlers. These matches will adhere to the established rules implemented since 2022, which include stipulations regarding tag team participation and elimination procedures. The specific details of the ruleset were confirmed ahead of the premium live event.

🌍 World

Entitled Behavior Exposed: Dozens of Screenshots Reveal Rude Interactions Online •

A collection of 30 screenshots circulating online depicts individuals exhibiting entitled behavior in various public settings. The images showcase instances of rudeness, disregard for service staff, and a perceived sense of superiority among the individuals involved. Many screenshots detail complaints about perceived inconveniences and demands for special treatment. The collection highlights a trend of individuals prioritizing their own needs and expectations over basic courtesy and respect for others. The posts have gained significant traction, sparking discussion about social etiquette and entitlement.

🦅 US

Sabrina Carpenter Confesses Hilarious Tequila Game During Tour Performances •

Singer Sabrina Carpenter revealed a playful stage ritual during her “Short N’ Sweet” tour. She admitted to throwing back tequila shots without knowing whether they contained alcohol or water. The revelation came as she described her approach to the unexpected moments on stage. Carpenter’s honesty offered a lighthearted glimpse into her performance style.

💰 Business

Man Dies in Shooting at Patrick Henry Mall; Investigation Underway •

A shooting at the Patrick Henry Mall in Newport News, Virginia, resulted in one man’s death on Saturday morning. Police responded to a reported shooting within a store at 10:52 a.m., arriving just one minute after the incident. Authorities found a deceased male at the scene, and an investigation is currently underway. The cause of the shooting and the identity of the victim are still under investigation by the Newport News Police Department.

💻 Technology

Black Friday AirPods Deals Surge: Pro 2 Discounts Lead the Early Offers •

Several significant discounts on Apple’s AirPods are available for Black Friday, primarily focusing on the AirPods Pro 2 model. Early deals offer reductions of up to 30% on the current generation AirPods Pro, making them significantly more affordable. These deals represent some of the earliest Black Friday offers for Apple’s wireless earbuds. The discounts are available through various retailers, including 9to5Toys and other online vendors.

🎭 Entertainment

Bob “Bongo” Starkie, Rock Legend, Dies After Year-Long Cancer Fight •

Bob “Bongo” Starkie, the iconic musician known for his band the Skyhooks, has died at the age of 73. Starkie’s death follows a year-long battle with leukemia. The Skyhooks confirmed his passing on Facebook, expressing sadness over the loss. Starkie’s career spanned decades and was marked by a famously unconventional lifestyle.

🏅 Sports

Lions’ Ragnow’s Comeback Attempt Ends After Failed Physical, Retirement Reinstated •

Detroit Lions center Frank Ragnow has reversed his decision to return from retirement following a failed physical examination. The team announced the news on Saturday, confirming that Ragnow will not be joining the roster. He had previously announced his intention to rejoin the team after a year away. The physical examination reportedly revealed concerns regarding a lingering injury, effectively ending his comeback attempt.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Two Massive ‘Continents’ Beneath Earth’s Core, Rewriting Planetary History •

Researchers have identified two substantial, continent-sized structures located approximately 1,800 miles beneath Earth’s surface. These Large Low Shear Velocity Provinces (LLSVPs) are significantly larger than previously estimated and appear to be remnants of a molten, early Earth. The structures are characterized by unusually low seismic wave velocities, suggesting they are composed of dense, buoyant material. Scientists believe these LLSVPs represent a period when the Earth’s core was significantly more active and may hold clues to the planet’s initial formation and evolution.

🩺 Health

Guyana Reports Rising HIV Cases, Ministry Urges Testing •

Guyana is experiencing a concerning increase in locally and regionally reported HIV cases. Health Minister Dr. Frank Anthony has called for increased testing, specifically utilizing the ministry’s free at-home HIV self-testing kits. The ministry’s initiative aims to facilitate early detection and intervention for individuals unaware of their status. Authorities are currently investigating the factors contributing to this rise in infections.
